'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Boko Haram insurgency]]
**More than 35 [[Islamic State – West Africa Province|ISWAP]] fighters are killed in [[airstrike]]s by the [[Nigerian Air Force]] during an attempted ground assault on troops near the [[Cameroon–Nigeria border]] in Kumshe, [[Borno State]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/africa/20250823-nigerian-airforce-kills-at-least-35-jihadists-near-border-with-cameroon (France 24)] [https://abcnews.go.com/International/wireStory/nigerias-military-airstrikes-killed-35-islamic-militants-borno-124922385 (ABC News)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Seven students are killed and 28 others are injured in [[drowning]]s on a school trip to the Abu Talat beach in Ajami, [[Alexandria]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.bbc.com/arabic/articles/cjw6gv2w9d9o (BBC News)] [https://people.com/students-drown-more-injured-school-trip-beach-alexandria-egypt-11796421 (''People'')]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Dharmasthala mass burial case]]
**[[Indian Police Service|Indian police]] arrest a man who recently alleged that he had been coerced into burying hundreds of bodies of women who were raped before being murdered from 1995 to 2014 at the [[Dharmasthala Temple]] in [[Dharmasthala]], [[Karnataka]], [[India]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cgm2z9zjgx7o (BBC News)]
*[[Pork barrel scam]]
**The [[Sandiganbayan]] [[appellate court]] of the [[Philippines]] sentences [[Janet Lim-Napoles]] to 55 years in prison over the diversion of [[Philippine Peso|₱]]7.55 million (US$133,600) in the [[Priority Development Assistance Fund]] involving [[Davao del Sur]] vice governor [[Marc Douglas Cagas IV]]. [https://newsinfo.inquirer.net/2099327/napoles-again-convicted-3-others-also-guilty-in-pork-scam-case (''Philippine Daily Inquirer'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2025 Syrian parliamentary election]]
**The [[Syria]]n [[Elections in Syria|electoral commission]] announces that the upcoming [[People's Assembly of Syria|parliamentary]] election will exclude the [[Al-Hasakah Governorate|Al-Hasakah]], [[Raqqa Governorate|Raqqa]], and [[Suwayda Governorate|Suwayda]] [[Governorates of Syria|governorates]] due to [[Southern Syria clashes (July 2025–present)|security concerns]], with seats for those regions left vacant until conditions allow voting. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/syria-delays-parliamentary-vote-sweida-after-sectarian-violence-2025-08-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[2025 Taiwanese referendum]]
**[[Taiwan]]'s [[Referendums in Taiwan|referendum]] on reopening the [[Maanshan Nuclear Power Plant]] in [[Pingtung County|Pingtung]] fails to meet the legal threshold for it to be binding, despite a majority voting in favor, leaving the facility closed as [[Government of the Republic of China|the government]] continues its shift toward [[Renewable energy in Taiwan|renewable energy]] and [[liquefied natural gas]]. [https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/taiwan-nuclear-plant-re-opening-vote-fails-approval-threshold-missed-2025-08-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2025–26 FIS Ski Jumping World Cup]]
**The [[International Ski and Snowboard Federation]] suspends [[Norway|Norwegian]] [[Ski jumping at the Winter Olympics|Olympic]] [[ski jumpers]] [[Johann André Forfang]] and [[Marius Lindvik]] for three months and fines them [[Swiss franc|CHF]] 2,000 (US$2,500) each after they admitted to equipment tampering during the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2025 – Men's individual large hill|men's large hill event]] at the [[FIS Nordic World Ski Championships 2025|2025 World Ski Championships]] in [[Trondheim]], Norway. [https://www.reuters.com/sports/ski-jumping-norways-lindvik-forfang-accept-suspensions-over-suit-tampering-2025-08-23/ (Reuters)]
